meta.title: 비교 대상의 생략
meta.note: 교재 p.84~85와 정답·해설 p.61의 대표 Q01~Q03 원문·정답 논리를 대조해 비교 대상 생략 중심의 대표 source-aligned QA 세트로 변환함.

items.sentence: It has been estimated that a child born in the United States today will consume at least twenty times as many natural resources during his or her lifetime as a child born in India and contribute about fifty times as much pollution to the environment.
items.prompt: will consume과 and로 병렬을 이루는 동사를 고르세요.
items.explanation: will consume ... and (will) contribute ...가 병렬 구조입니다.

items.sentence: It has been estimated that a child born in the United States today will consume at least twenty times as many natural resources during his or her lifetime as a child born in India and contribute about fifty times as much pollution to the environment.
items.prompt: as a child born in India 뒤에서 생략된 핵심 동사구를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 인도에서 태어난 아이가 평생 천연자원을 소비할 것보다라는 비교 대상이 문맥상 명백해 will consume natural resources가 생략됩니다.

items.sentence: In the experiment, two thirds of the subjects who were alone noticed the emergency immediately, but only 25 percent of those in groups saw it as quickly.
items.explanation: 25 percent of those in groups는 집단에 있던 실험 대상자들의 25%라는 의미이므로 those는 the subjects를 가리킵니다.

items.sentence: In the experiment, two thirds of the subjects who were alone noticed the emergency immediately, but only 25 percent of those in groups saw it as quickly.
items.prompt: as quickly 뒤에서 생략된 비교 대상으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: as two thirds of the subjects who were alone noticed the emergency immediately
items.answer: as two thirds of the subjects who were alone noticed the emergency immediately
items.explanation: 집단에 있던 대상자들이 비상사태를 알아차린 속도를 혼자 있던 대상자들의 속도와 비교합니다.

items.sentence: Poetry has the virtue of being able to say twice as much as prose in half the time, and the drawback, if you do not give it your full attention, of seeming to say half as much in twice the time.
items.prompt: half as much 뒤에서 생략된 세 단어를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 앞에서 이미 밝혀진 비교 대상이므로 as prose says가 생략된 것으로 해설됩니다.
